content: UR3e e-Series has built-in tool-centric force/torque sensing (estimated from joint motor current) sufficient for collision detection (ISO/TS 15066 safety stops), push-until-contact routines, and basic force-controlled tasks like assembly/sanding/deburring. Not precise below ~2N; a dedicated 6-axis F/T sensor (e.g. OnRobot HEX, Robotiq FT) is used when finer force measurement is needed.
